source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents (frontmatter table, resolution order, limitations) and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (the plugin-shipped agent restriction and its supported-field list), cross-checked against strings in the installed 2.1.269 binary. The delegate_scope entry is sourced in adapters/claude-code/agent-interface.json. Full contract with per-claim provenance: AI_Codex/Knowledge/Claude Code Subagent Contract.md.

explicit_model.verified: Documented values sonnet/opus/haiku/fable, a full model id, or inherit. Resolution order is per-invocation parameter, then frontmatter, then CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then the parent's model — so an unset field inherits and must never be left unset.

reasoning_effort.verified: Documented frontmatter field taking low/medium/high/xhigh/max, overriding the session effort level. `claude --help` exposes the matching --effort <level> session flag, and `effort` appears among the agent spawn option keys in the 2.1.234 binary. This corrects the previous revision, which asserted effort was unsettable here.

tool_allowlist.verified: Documented frontmatter field; omitting it inherits every available tool, so it is always written explicitly.

tool_denylist.verified: Documented frontmatter field, resolved before `tools`: denials are removed from the pool first, then the allowlist applies to what remains.

read_only_enforced.verified: Enforced by the host, not by instruction: an agent whose `tools` omits Edit, Write and NotebookEdit has no write tool to call. The paired `disallowedTools` entry is belt-and-braces against a later inherited grant.

scoped_hooks.verified: plugins-reference states that hooks, mcpServers and permissionMode are NOT supported for plugin-shipped agents, and this plugin ships as a plugin — so the frontmatter field exists for hand-written agents but is ignored for every agent we distribute. Recorded as true until 2026-09-14 on the strength of the field existing; that was a claim about the host rather than about our distribution channel. This plugin uses session-wide hooks keyed on the agent_type that PreToolUse carries, which is why the prohibitions still hold.

ask-owner.verified: AskUserQuestion is in the documented set of tools removed from every subagent unconditionally (sub-agents, 'Tools always removed'), alongside EnterPlanMode, EndConversation and others. No tool grant can reinstate it, so the prohibition cannot be violated here.

main_thread.verified: Both sub-blocks read from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents on 2026-09-17, and recorded per claim with the source's own words in adapters/claude-code/agent-interface.json.

delegate_scope.verified: Documented syntax inside the `tools` allowlist: "Use Agent(agent_type) syntax to restrict which subagent types can be spawned". The doc also scopes it - the parenthesised list applies only to an agent running as the main thread with `claude --agent`, and in a subagent definition it is ignored. Both halves are recorded because the second is what makes this a guarantee for root and an instruction for the orchestrator. type_template follows the plugin reference's naming rule, quoted in the interface file: an agent file in a plugin loads as <plugin>:<agent>, so that is the name a type list must match.

initial_prompt.verified: Documented frontmatter field: "No auto-submission if omitted; only used when agent runs as main session via --agent or agent setting." The scoping is the point - it is auto-submission for root and dead weight in a dispatched agent's file, so the renderer emits it only for a main-thread agent.
